category_note: multivariable-calculus remains a provisional category: upstream has no dedicated category, while partial derivatives live under derivatives/.

notes.writer: Provisional category. 3 figure briefs. n-dimensional test proved from Taylor; determinant form stated. Links to Taylor and Lagrange siblings are unpublished batch dependencies.
notes.illustrator: 3 original SVGs. Rendered in Chrome at 680 px and 240 px and visually inspected. Level c=-2,-3 omitted from the contour brief because the global minimum is -1.

notes.writer: Provisional category. 3 figure briefs. One- and several-constraint theorems; sensitivity interpretation. Link to the implicit function theorem is an unpublished batch dependency.
notes.illustrator: 3 original SVGs. The lifted-circle projection was chosen so the projected curve is a simple closed loop; gradient lengths are proportional to the vector norms. Rendered at 680 px and 240 px and inspected.

notes.writer: Provisional category. 3 figure briefs. General theorem proved by contraction mapping; C^k by induction. Links to inverse-function and Lagrange siblings are unpublished batch dependencies.
notes.illustrator: 3 original SVGs. Rendered at 680 px and 240 px and inspected. Contraction figure explicitly marked schematic.

notes.writer: Provisional category. 3 figure briefs. Main proof via the implicit function theorem; direct contraction argument summarised. Link to the implicit function theorem is an unpublished batch dependency.
notes.illustrator: 3 original SVGs. Local-bijection figure uses f(x,y)=(x+y^2/4, y+x^2/4); polar figure uses a full annulus with the image half shaded. Rendered at 680 px and 240 px and inspected.
